interpretation: Across four batches and two observations per candidate order, compact claim-link batching preserved every structured decision and reduced median provider input by 47.2% against matched direct calls. Median completion was 7.8% faster, but latency remained substantially more variable than input usage.
recommendation: Adopt batch size two as the tested default for independent read-only critiques sharing model, effort, policy boundary, and compact claim-link contract. Treat input reduction as the primary expected benefit and latency reduction as secondary.
